description: This file defines the Message class for handling notification messages in the OpenMRS health application, including attributes for recipients, sender, subject, content, attachment, and timestamps, along with methods for managing these properties.

classes.name: Message
classes.description: Represents a notification message with properties such as recipients, sender, subject, content, attachments, and sent date.

methods.name: Message (constructor)
methods.description: Constructors for creating Message instances with various parameters including IDs, recipients, sender, subject, content, and attachments.

methods.name: setRecipients
methods.description: Sets the recipients of the message, replacing existing recipients.

methods.name: getRecipients
methods.description: Returns the recipients as a comma-separated string.

methods.name: addRecipient
methods.description: Adds a recipient to the existing recipient list.

methods.name: setSender
methods.description: Sets the sender of the message.

methods.name: getSender
methods.description: Returns the sender of the message.

methods.name: setSentDate
methods.description: Sets the date when the message was sent.

methods.name: setContent
methods.description: Sets the content of the message.

methods.name: setContentType
methods.description: Sets the content type of the message.

methods.name: hasAttachment
methods.description: Returns true if the message has an attachment.
